Highly consistent 3yo from the Bart Rice barn carrying a featherweight 116 lbs (52.5kg). Has excellent positional tactical speed to track the pacesetters and pounce on the turn.
Produced a blistering 99 speed figure when finishing 2nd behind Saenae Hunter over 1200m on July 17. Drawn well inside to save ground along the rail before launching late.
Rail-drawn front-running threat who clocked a sharp 1:12.40 when runner-up to Open Sky on June 28. If allowed an uncontested lead from Barrier 1, will be tough to catch.
Top jockey Seo Seung Un takes over. Ran a solid 3rd behind Saenae Hunter and Huimang Rani last out while carrying light weight. Capable of hitting the board at a price.
